note: Wayne County Conservation park (still called Bobwhite State Park, but county-run) 2 mi west of Allerton, beside Bobwhite Lake (electric motors only); the camp loop sits in the woods north of County Road J46, with 5 mi of trails through restored prairie. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 FCFS (no reservations), modern shower house, season April 1 - Dec 1 (opens/closes added). Site count (32) and 20-amp electric left as recorded but unconfirmed by the county. Not waterfront confirmed: the camp loop is ~130 m from the upper arm of the lake through continuous woods, and the lower lake is across J46. Pin ~330 m off (it sits on the lake).
